theorem_cxci: Theorem CXCI (Golay Code Bridge): The W(3,3) graph parameters index all four Golay codes and both the E8 and Leech lattices with zero free parameters. The extended ternary Golay [12,6,6]_3 has length K=12, dimension K/2=6, distance K/2=6, and alphabet Q=3. The perfect ternary Golay [11,6,5]_3 has length K-1=11 (M-theory dimension), correction capacity lambda=2. The E8 root system has rank J^{-1}=8 and kissing number equal to the edge count of W(3,3) (both 240). The Leech lattice has rank 2K=24 and kissing number E*Q^2*Phi6*Phi3=196560.
